Job Title:
Lead Program Manager
Job Description
We're Concentrix. The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent. Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

As a Lead Program Manager, you will lead strategic planning, execution, governance, and continuous improvement of large-scale automotive programs supporting OEMs, dealer networks, training consulting leads, and automotive retail initiatives. In this role, you will serve as the primary leader coordinating cross-functional teams across strategy, IT, analytics and reporting, client services, technology, creative services, and operations to deliver measurable business outcomes. What you will do in this role
In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.
Some key responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Lead end-to-end delivery of large, multi-million-dollar automotive programs across OEM, dealer network, and consultants
- Manage dependencies across multiple workstreams, vendors, platforms, and stakeholders to keep programs moving forward.
- Serve as the primary program lead for OEM and dealer-facing stakeholders, building trusted relationships with executive sponsors and key decision-makers.
- Excel skills (Advanced Excel skills including complex data manipulation) and understanding of sales trends and objectives
- Ability to understand multiple workstreams regarding reporting information that may contain multiple excel files from OEM and support client with long term plan to automate
- Ability to work with several different client business owners with different requirements which relate to the overall business objectives as a whole
- Evaluate new technologies, AI capabilities, and automation opportunities that align with business objectives
- Drive operational excellence through standardized processes, governance discipline, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Work alongside other Program Managers and help coordinate deliverables and objectives with Operations teams, Data Analysts, Creative Teams, Technology Teams, Operations Leaders, and Vendor Partners.
- Define priorities and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and high performance
- Collaboration with existing Program Managers well versed in the day to day requirements of the program
- Identify risks impacting profitability, delivery commitments, capacity planning, and staffing strategies.

- Develop and maintain program roadmaps, timelines, risk registers, governance frameworks, and delivery plans.
- Establish program KPIs, business outcome measures, and performance reporting aligned with client objectives.
- Facilitate quarterly business reviews, executive briefings, and strategic planning sessions.
- Translate client business objectives into actionable marketing, technology, analytics, and operational initiatives.
- Ensure alignment between OEM brand standards and retailer marketing execution.

- Manage program budgets, forecasts, resource plans, and financial performance against contractual and operational targets
- Drive innovation through personalization, segmentation, and data-driven marketing approaches.
- Develop executive dashboards and reporting that provide visibility into program health and business impact.

Your qualifications
We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.

Concentrix is a great match if you:
- Have deep automotive industry knowledge, including experience supporting OEMs, dealer networks, or automotive retail initiatives.
- Bring strong program management expertise with the ability to lead complex, large-scale marketing programs from strategy through execution.
- Strong excel skills and understanding of Power BI Platform and sales reporting
- Can build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders, client partners, dealer-facing teams, vendors, and cross-functional delivery teams.
- Are skilled at translating business objectives into clear roadmaps, workstreams, deliverables, KPIs, and measurable outcomes.
- Have experience leading teams across marketing strategy, analytics, client services, technology, creative services, operations, and vendor partners.
- Use data to assess program performance, results, risks, and opportunities.
- Are comfortable managing budgets, forecasts, resource plans, risks, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
- Communicate clearly and confidently in internal and client facing meetings.
- Thrive in a fast-paced environment where collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement matter.

It will be a plus if you:
- Have experience with Salesforce, Automotive Cloud, Dealer Management Systems, Customer Data Platforms, or marketing automation technologies.
- Have experience using AI or automation tools to improve productivity
- Have experience developing executive dashboards, governance frameworks, risk registers, and performance reporting.

What's in it for you
We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW.
In this role, we offer benefits that help support your unique lifestyle:

The base salary range for this position is $85,000 - $100,000 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days.
The deadline to apply for this position is: October 16, 2026. This position is for an existing, immediate vacancy. We are currently seeking to fill this role with an individual who can start as soon as possible.

Power the best version of you!
At Concentrix, we invest in our game-changers because we know that when our people thrive, our clients and their customers thrive.
If all this feels like the perfect next step in your career journey, we want to hear from you. Apply today and discover why over 440k+ game-changers around the globe call Concentrix their “employer of choice.”

Job Title:
Professionnel(le) I – Planification et Analyse Financière (FP&A)
Job Description
1- Qui sommes-nous ?
Concentrix est un leader mondial de l’expérience client, présent dans plus de 70 pays. Chez Concentrix Bénin, nous plaçons l’humain, l’innovation et l’excellence opérationnelle au cœur de nos activités.

Dans le cadre du renforcement de notre département Finance, nous recherchons un(e) Professionnel(le) I – Planification et Analyse Financière (FP&A) capable de contribuer au pilotage de la performance financière de l’entreprise à travers la production de reportings financiers et opérationnels, l’analyse des résultats, le suivi budgétaire et la préparation des prévisions financières.

Le/La titulaire du poste contribuera à garantir la fiabilité, la qualité et la pertinence des informations financières utilisées par le management pour le suivi de la performance et la prise de décision. Il/Elle participera également aux processus de clôture, de budget, de Forecast et de Rolling Forecast ainsi qu’à l’amélioration continue des outils et processus de reporting financier.

2- Pourquoi rejoindre Concentrix ?
En rejoignant Concentrix Bénin, vous intégrerez un environnement international, dynamique et multiculturel, où la collaboration, le développement des compétences et l’amélioration continue occupent une place importante.
Vous aurez l’opportunité de contribuer directement au pilotage de la performance financière de l’organisation, de travailler avec les équipes opérationnelles et les fonctions support et de participer à des processus financiers structurants tels que le reporting, la budgétisation, le Forecast et le Rolling Forecast.

3-Mission principale
Contribuer au pilotage de la performance financière de l'entreprise en assurant la préparation des reportings financiers, l'analyse des résultats, le suivi budgétaire et la production de prévisions financières fiables. Le titulaire du poste accompagne les opérations et les fonctions support dans la compréhension des résultats financiers et l'identification des leviers d'amélioration de la performance. Les activités FP&A au sein de Concentrix s'appuient notamment sur les processus de budgétisation, reporting, analyse des écarts et forecast.

4- Principales responsabilités et activités

A-Reporting financier
Participer aux clôtures mensuelles.
Préparer et consolider les reportings financiers et opérationnels.
Contrôler la fiabilité, l'exhaustivité et la cohérence des données financières.
Assurer le rapprochement entre les données de gestion et la comptabilité.
Produire les indicateurs clés de performance dans le respect du calendrier de clôture.

B-Analyse financière
Analyser les écarts entre Réalisé, Budget, Forecast et Rolling Forecast.
Identifier les facteurs expliquant les variations de chiffre d'affaires, de marge brute et de NGOI.
Réaliser des analyses de rentabilité par client, projet, site ou département.
Préparer des synthèses et recommandations à destination du management.
Participer aux revues mensuelles de performance.

C- Budget et prévisions
Participer à l'élaboration du budget annuel.
Contribuer aux exercices de Forecast et Rolling Forecast.
Collecter et consolider les hypothèses opérationnelles et financières.
Assurer le suivi des objectifs budgétaires et des plans d'action associés.
Participer à l'identification des risques et opportunités financiers.

D-Business Partnering
Collaborer avec les équipes opérationnelles et les fonctions support.
Fournir des analyses permettant d'éclairer la prise de décision.
Accompagner les responsables opérationnels dans le suivi de leurs indicateurs de performance.
Participer aux réunions de gestion et aux revues financières.

5-Profil recherché

A- Formation
Bac +4/5 en Finance, Contrôle de Gestion, Comptabilité, Audit ou domaine équivalent.

B- Expérience
Première expérience en contrôle de gestion, FP&A, audit ou finance d'entreprise appréciée.
Connaissance des activités de reporting et de planification financière.

C- Compétences techniques
Maîtrise avancée d'Excel.
Bonne compréhension des états financiers et des indicateurs de performance.
Capacités d'analyse financière et de modélisation.
Maîtrise des outils de reporting et de planification financière.
Connaissance des outils tels que Excel, Power BI, Planful, Domo et Workday.

D- Compétences comportementales
Forte capacité d'analyse et de synthèse.
Rigueur et sens de l'organisation.
Esprit d'équipe.

Capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément.

7- Principaux indicateurs de performance

Job Title:
Program Manager, Marketing Solutions
Job Description
We're Concentrix. The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent. Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.
Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.
Position Summary
As a Program Manager , you will plan, coordinate, and deliver automotive marketing and customer engagement programs from initiation through completion. You will manage project schedules, budgets, scopes, risks, and cross-functional teams to ensure CRM, digital, direct mail, loyalty, retention, and customer lifecycle marketing initiatives are delivered accurately, on time, and within budget.

This role is ideal for a highly organized, collaborative, and client-focused professional who is comfortable working across multiple teams, presenting to stakeholders, and managing competing priorities with limited direction.

What you will do in this role:

In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.
- Manage end-to-end execution of automotive marketing campaigns and client projects
- Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, budgets, forecasts, status reports, and project documentation
- Collaborate cross-functionally with Creative, Development, Analytics, QA, Production, Client Success, technology teams, and vendor partners
- Facilitate client and internal stakeholder meetings, gather requirements, and document business objectives
- Create and deliver clear, polished PowerPoint presentations for internal teams and client-facing discussions
- Monitor project scope, risks, issues, dependencies, and change requests, escalating when appropriate
- Ensure campaign deliverables meet quality standards, business requirements, and client expectations
- Support estimates, statements of work, billing requirements, and project financial tracking
- Track project performance against key success measures, including on-time delivery, budget adherence, client satisfaction, quality, and stakeholder communication
- Maintain strong client relationships through proactive communication, follow-up, confidentiality, and issue resolution
- Work independently with minimal direction while keeping teams aligned, informed, and accountable
- Support one or multiple client accounts depending on business needs and skill set
- Drive process improvements and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency
- Balance competing priorities in a fast-paced environment with flexibility, sound judgment, and an open-minded approach
- Travel locally for client visits as needed, up to 10% or less

Your qualifications
We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.

Concentrix is a great match if you :
- Have 6–7 years of experience in project management, marketing campaign management, client delivery, or a related field
- Bring a combination of relevant education and experience; a bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Project Management, Business, or a related field is preferred
- Have experience managing marketing campaigns, customer engagement programs, CRM initiatives, digital marketing, direct mail, loyalty, retention, or customer lifecycle programs
- Are highly organized and able to manage timelines, budgets, deliverables, documentation, risks, and stakeholder expectations
- Communicate clearly and professionally, with strong English written and verbal communication skills
- Are comfortable presenting to internal stakeholders and clients, including developing polished PowerPoint presentations
- Work well independently and collaboratively, with the ability to move initiatives forward without needing significant direction
- Are a strong team player who can build trust across cross-functional teams and client groups
- Can manage multiple priorities, shifting deadlines, and either single-client or multi-client project environments
- Demonstrate flexibility, open-mindedness, discretion, and a strong commitment to confidentiality
- Are proficient with Microsoft Office, Microsoft Teams, project management tools, reporting processes, and documentation practices
- Have advanced Excel skills, including the ability to organize, analyze, and report on project or financial information
- Are comfortable with light local travel for client visits

It will be a plus if you:
- Are bilingual in English and French
- Have experience working in the automotive industry
- Have Salesforce experience
- Have experience working directly with clients and supporting client-facing project delivery
- Have experience supporting statements of work, estimates, billing, forecasting, or project financial tracking
- Bring strong process improvement skills and a continuous improvement mindset

What's in it for you
We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW.
In this role, we offer benefits that help support your unique lifestyle:

The base salary range for this position is $60k- $70k, plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, registered retirement savings plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days. The deadline to apply for this position is Oct 12, 2026.
This position is for an existing, immediate vacancy. We are currently seeking to fill this role with an individual who can start as soon as possible.

Business Development & Solution Design Specialist
Position Overview:
Concentrix is seeking a driven and technically astute Business Development & Solution Design Specialist. This hybrid role bridges high-impact outbound pipeline generation with front-line consultative solutioning. In this position, you will be responsible for identifying, prospecting, and engaging prospective enterprise clients, while working collaboratively to architect tailored customer experience (CX), digital transformation, and business process outsourcing (BPO) solutions. You will serve as the initial strategic touchpoint for enterprise accounts, translating complex operational bottlenecks into viable, technology-enabled operational models. A critical component of this role involves rigorous tracking and the delivery of detailed weekly performance reports to leadership.

Key Responsibilities :

1.Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation
- Identify, research, and map key enterprise target accounts across designated verticals (e.g., Technology, Retail/E-Commerce, Banking & Financial Services, Travel & Hospitality).
- Execute multi-channel outbound campaigns (cold outreach, social selling, etc.)
- Qualify inbound and outbound enterprise opportunities, uncovering business pains, buying cycles, and budget parameters.
- Manage and maintain accurate pipeline data, account research, and outreach metrics within CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce).
- Design, maintain, and present comprehensive weekly Excel reports detailing pipeline health, outreach conversion metrics, meeting booking rates, and account engagement progress to sales leadership.

2. Consultative Solutioning & Pre-Sales Design
- Partner with Commercial Directors, Enterprise Sales Leaders, and Solution Architects to co-design bespoke service delivery models (onshore, nearshore, offshore, and work-at-home models).
- Conduct preliminary discovery sessions to gather requirements regarding staffing volumes (FTEs), operating hours, technology stacks, contact channel mix (voice, chat, social, AI bot deflection), and language requirements.
- Contribute to commercial pricing inputs, volume forecasts, and scope-of-work assumptions alongside Pricing and Operations teams, heavily utilizing Excel to build out initial staffing models, cost estimations, and scenario analyses.

3. Pitch & Proposal Development (RFP / RFI)
- Contribute directly to RFP/RFI responses, ensuring value propositions, case studies, and solution narratives are aligned with client objectives.
- Build compelling, executive-ready presentation decks, business case justifications, and ROI models for client discovery and pitch meetings.
- Participate actively in prospective client pitches, articulating the operational, technological, and commercial value of the proposed solution.

Core Skills & Competencies
Technical & Industry Expertise
- Advanced Microsoft Excel Proficiency: Deep capability in data manipulation, complex formulas, PivotTables, conditional formatting.
- BPO & CX Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of contact center operations, customer journey design, SLA/KPI metrics, and operating models
- Pipeline Management Tools: Proficiency in modern sales enablement and CRM tools (Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.
- Proposal & Solution Engineering: Ability to structure formal RFPs, pitch presentations, and basic operational staffing/costing frameworks.

Professional & Consultative Strengths

- Strategic Prospecting: Proven ability to penetrate enterprise accounts and secure discovery meetings with senior decision-makers.
- Consultative Problem Solving: Ability to quickly synthesize raw client data, diagnose inefficiencies, and recommend structured solution frameworks.
- Collaboration & Orchestration: High capability to work cross-functionally across Operations, Legal, Pricing, Workforce Management (WFM), and Technical Solution teams.

- 3-6 years of experience in enterprise business development, pre-sales solutioning, sales engineering, or related commercial roles.

- Strong analytical capabilities with proven experience building and managing data-driven operational models and reports using Microsoft Excel .
- Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
- Ability to translate business requirements into commercial and operational solutions.

Job Title:
Professional, BI Analyst (TCF)
Job Description
We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to be the analytics partner for our local business — the person the team turns to when they need to know what happened, what is about to happen, and what to do about it.

This is a hybrid position by design. Day to day, you sit with the local business: building and maintaining the dashboards they rely on, surfacing trends before they become surprises, and translating numbers into recommended actions. At the same time, you work as part of the Global BI team, which owns the data platform, the shared data models, and the reporting standards. Your job is to keep those two worlds connected — so that when the business changes, the data infrastructure changes with it, and when the global platform changes, local reporting keeps running without disruption.

Success in this role is not measured by the number of dashboards produced. It is measured by whether the business makes better and faster decisions because you are here. Turn data into insight
- Monitor performance against targets and highlight trends, anomalies, and inflection points proactively, rather than waiting to be asked.
- Perform root-cause and driver analysis to explain why a metric moved, not just that it moved.
- Identify emerging risks — pipeline gaps, margin erosion, demand shifts, service or cost outliers — early enough for the business to act.
- Translate findings into clear, specific, prioritized recommendations, with an honest read on confidence and what further data would sharpen the answer.
- Present to local leadership in plain business language; tailor depth to the audience.

Build and maintain reporting the business trusts
- Design, build, and maintain dashboards and self-service reports covering core commercial and operational KPIs.
- Own the full lifecycle of local reporting assets: requirements gathering, build, testing, documentation, rollout, and retirement of what is no longer used.
- Maintain data quality and reconciliation checks so reported numbers match the source of truth; investigate and resolve discrepancies at the root cause rather than patching the output.
- Keep documentation current — metric definitions, calculation logic, refresh schedules, and known limitations.

Partner with the business
- Act as the first point of contact for local analytics and reporting requests; triage, scope, and prioritize them against business impact.
- Sit close to the commercial, operations, and finance teams to understand how the business actually works, not only how it is represented in the data.
- Challenge requests constructively — clarify the decision behind the ask, and propose a better route when a requested report will not answer the real question.
- Coach business users toward self-service so routine questions do not require a ticket.
- Design, build, and maintain dashboards and self-service reports covering core commercial and operational KPIs.
Own the full lifecycle of local reporting assets: requirements gathering, build, testing, documentation, rollout, and retirement of what is no longer used.
Maintain data quality and reconciliation checks so reported numbers match the source of truth; investigate and resolve discrepancies at the root cause rather than patching the output.
Keep documentation current — metric definitions, calculation logic, refresh schedules, and known limitations.

Connect local and global

- Adopt and apply global standards for data modelling, naming, security, and visualization; flag where a genuine local exception is warranted and make the case for it.
- Contribute local solutions back to the global team where they can be reused in other markets.

- Demonstrated ability to move from a raw business question to a defensible answer with a clear recommendation.
- Excellent communication skills: you can explain a technical constraint to a business stakeholder and a business nuance to an engineer, and be understood by both.
- Comfortable working across time zones with a distributed team, and self-directed enough to make progress without daily supervision.
- Business fluency in English.

- Strong understanding of LinkedIn and B2B social-media marketing.

Turn data into direction. Transform insights into impact.

Marketing Specialist - Digital Paid Media
Job Description
Experience the power of a game-changing career

Are you looking for what’s next? We’re a global technology and services leader that powers the brands of the future. At Concentrix, our experience design and engineering team reimagines customer experience through strategy, talent, and technology.

Within our Marketing Solutions team, we deliver performance-based, omni-channel marketing strategies for leading global brands; leveraging data, creativity, and technology across email, search, programmatic, and social platforms.

If you’re looking to grow and be inspired, as a Specialist, Digital Planning in Barcelona, you will play a key role in shaping and optimizing digital campaigns that drive real business impact.

What you will do in this role

- Support the development of digital media strategies across Programmatic Display, Social, and Search, collaborating with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
- Build and document digital communication plans, contributing innovative ideas to go-to-market strategies.
- Execute and optimize campaigns in partnership with operations teams, ensuring high-quality delivery and performance consistency.
- Monitor campaign performance and provide data-driven insights and optimization recommendations on a regular basis (real-time and periodic).
- Stay up to date with industry trends, tools, and partners, identifying opportunities to enhance capabilities and innovation.
- Collaborate across teams to ensure alignment between digital and non-digital planning, supporting integrated marketing strategies.

Concentrix is a great match if you have:

- 1–3 years of experience in digital media, marketing strategy, or campaign management.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and generate actionable insights.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt messaging to different audiences and stakeholders.
- Experience or familiarity with Programmatic, Social, Search, or digital marketing platforms.
- Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
- Proactive, detail-oriented, and innovative mindset, with the ability to drive ideas and contribute to business initiatives.

What’s in it for you

- Hybrid work model
- Full-time 39 hours/week – permanent contract
- Competitive Salary
- Great location in Barcelona
- Bring-a-friend (referral) bonus opportunities
- Full paid training on the company
- Career development programs and specialized courses

Experience the best version of you!

If this feels like the perfect next step in your career journey, we want to hear from you. Apply today and help shape the future of digital marketing with Concentrix.

We're proudly united as one team, one company, globally. We're committed to equal employment opportunities for all candidates and a work environment free from discrimination and harassment. jobs.description:
Job Title:
Operations Manager I
Job Description
The Operations Manager I is responsible for coaching and supervising a group of Team Leaders. This position is also responsible for ensuring Client Service Level Agreement and financial expectations are achieved. Essential Functions/Core Responsibilities
• Analyze and maintain all Client Service Level Agreements; implement improvement plans as needed

• Maximize revenue generation to reach long and short term financial projects (i.e. data collection for billable/non-billable hours, forecasting, budgeting, etc.)

• Selecting, training, developing, and managing performance of direct reports and their associates; including planning and assigning work for staff in accordance with the organization’s policies and applicable legal requirements

• Manage and review operational reports (Attendance adherence, PFP, Client scorecard, Metrics management reports)

• Create and maximize relationships with client partners

• Provide leadership and guidance to direct reports  to ensure consistent administration of company policies and standards;  define and implement any corrective actions needed to meet operational performance

• Conduct regular one-on-ones with direct reports to review individual performance, the performance of their team and offer on-going developmental coaching

• Create a positive work environment  through employee engagement; resolve employee relation issues in a professional and timely manner

• Participate in cross functional meetings to review information received from operational support functions - Training, HR, Quality, WFM, TA.- and partner to define action plans that resolve issues and drive continuous improvement

• Implement best practices and over-deliver for clients, drive consistent performance, evaluate staffing needs, with input from BD and Client and make adjustments to meet changing requirements

• Attend business reviews with the client

• Handle a team of team leaders

Candidate Profile
• Associate's Degree in related field with more than seven years of experience (with at least two years of Progressive Management Experience) preferred

• Call center experience preferred

• Demonstrated ability to coach and develop action plans, which maximize performance, and provide effective feedback

• Demonstrated ability to analyze and improve work processes; establish a course of action for self and others to accomplish a specific goal

• Work well under pressure and follow through on items to completion while maintaining professional demeanor

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Ability to effectively present information to internal and external associates

• Demonstrated ability to organize and prioritize projects in a fast-paced and deadline-oriented business environment

• Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach and provide direction to a team of employees

• Willingness to work a flexible schedule

Career Framework Role
Manages professional employees and/or supervisors or supervises large, complex technical or business support or production operations team(s).  Is accountable for the performance and results of a team within own discipline or function.  Receives assignments in the form of objectives and determines how to use resources to meet schedules and goals.  Adapts departmental plans and priorities to resolve operational challenges.  Decisions are guided by policies, procedures and business plan; receives guidance from senior manager and/or director.  Provides technical guidance to employees, colleagues and/or customers.  Has accountability for results in terms of costs, strategies and employees.

Job Title:
Operations Supervisor – Delivery Robotics Operation
Job Description
The Operations Supervisor is responsible for leading and overseeing a team of Pilots who remotely operate delivery robots. This role ensures real-time operational continuity, performance management through key metrics, and adherence to service level agreements, while maintaining high standards of communication, leadership, and operational excellence. Responsibilities

- Lead, coach, and supervise a team of Pilots responsible for the remote operation of delivery robots.
- Monitor live operations in real time, identifying deviations, risks, or incidents and implementing timely corrective actions.
- Track, analyze, and report operational KPIs to ensure productivity, quality, and SLA compliance.
- Provide continuous feedback, performance coaching, and emotional support to maintain stable and efficient team performance.
- Escalate operational or technical incidents following established protocols.
- Ensure compliance with operational procedures, safety standards, and client requirements.
- Maintain clear, professional, and assertive communication with internal stakeholders and client representatives.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives through data analysis and operational optimization.

Requirements

- Proven experience as an Operations Supervisor, Team Leader, or similar role, preferably within a BPO or real-time operations environment.
- Strong experience managing operational metrics and performance indicators.
- English proficiency at B2 level or higher (written and verbal).
- Experience or strong familiarity with remote-controlled devices, such as:
- Drones
- Remote-operated vehicles
- Video game consoles or controllers (PS5)
- Strong leadership, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to perform effectively in high-pressure, real-time operational environments.
- On site position, full time availability es required

Competencies
- Leadership and team development
- Analytical and results-driven mindset
- Assertive and professional communication
- Emotional intelligence and stress management
- Adaptability to technology-driven operations
